patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I've been throwing up and having diarrhea since yesterday — can't keep water down. A few of us got sick after the potluck. I'm lightheaded when I stand up.
presentation.triageNote: 30-year-old female with one day of vomiting and diarrhea after several people became ill following a potluck. She cannot keep fluids down and has dry mucous membranes and mild lightheadedness on standing.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 3 is appropriate because persistent vomiting with inability to tolerate fluids and clinical dehydration is expected to require multiple treatment and assessment resources.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has an outbreak-associated gastrointestinal illness with dehydration and orthostatic symptoms.
clinical.acuityReason: She is not in shock and has no focal abdominal warning signs, but failed oral intake requires IV treatment and reassessment.
keyFindings: One day of vomiting and diarrhea
teachingPoints: Bloody stool, focal or severe abdominal pain, high fever, prolonged symptoms, or immunocompromise would broaden the evaluation.
Successful oral rehydration after treatment is an important disposition check.

possibleDiagnoses: Other causes of vomiting and diarrhea
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: IV rehydration, antiemetic treatment, and laboratory assessment would be followed by an oral challenge and discharge if symptoms and hydration improve.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: slumped, clutching her stomach, holding an emesis bag
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 30-year-old woman, pale and washed-out, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped, one hand on her stomach, holding a small emesis bag. Expression: queasy and drained. Clearly visible: a hand on the stomach and an emesis bag. No text, no logos.
